essence: At night, after dividing the substance into three parts, one should cast it into the heart.
One should first worship the lord of gaṇas with fragrance, flowers, food offerings, and the like.
After chanting, one should worship with devotion using yellow-colored flowers.
One should take auspicious śāli rice grains measured to one prastha.
One should add jaggery and coconut in a quantity equal to the previous measure.
